Gate 2 remains mandatory per slice and per wave. Gate 3 remains human-gated; this run stops at master.

gate3_hotfix.note: v2.7.0 took production down: hub-sdk 1.3.x added an undocumented CSRF origin guard that 403s every BFF POST when the web app and API are on different hosts, which is this product's topology. Entitled operators saw a blank screen then the session recovery panel. Fixed forward, because rolling back to v2.5.0 was NOT safe - migration 0021 added absolute_expires_at NOT NULL and v2.5.0 code does not write it. Gate 2 PASS by a separate Verify agent with 14 CSRF bypass attempts all rejected. Production CORS_ORIGIN verified against the live API before promoting; the fix confirmed live (403 to 401, browser reached /tatico/dashboard). master == staging == production == e8a5810.
